explication: New Expensify is a cross-platform chat and payments application. The principal user journey is entering the app, navigating conversations, and initiating expense or payment workflows; the README describes the product as payments built on chat. The graph also preserves routing, shared state, HTML message rendering, onboarding, and native integrations. Many application areas are represented by directories because their implementation was not sampled; dashed, uncited edges indicate plausible but unverified flow rather than inspected calls.
